entities.name: EFM2 (P38347)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to curated Saccharomyces cerevisiae EFM2; 419 aa, 100% identity and coverage, E-value 3.54e-312.
Predicted molecular weight is 47,976 Da and theoretical pI is 4.86; calculated charge at pH 7 is approximately -22.7.
Contains a Methyltransf_16 domain (PF10294.16) at residues 216–384, supporting SAM-dependent methyltransferase activity.
Curated function: S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent protein-lysine N-methyltransferase that mono- and dimethylates elongation factor 2 at Lys-613 and methylates elongation factor 3A.
Curated localization is cytoplasmic; EC class is 2.1.1.-.

Associated GO terms include protein methyltransferase activity, protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity, SAM-dependent methyltransferase activity, cytoplasm, and positive regulation of translational termination.

entities.name: Elongation factor 2
observations: EFM2 methylates Lys-613 of yeast elongation factor 2 according to the curated reference annotation.
The modification is associated with regulation of translational termination.

entities.name: Elongation factor 3A
observations: Yeast EFM2 is also annotated to methylate elongation factor 3A.
